description: Command vocabulary of this target's linear cost model, in summation order. preload is not a regressor: it is issued 1:1 with compute in weight-stationary code, so its cost is inside compute's coefficient. mvin3_bias (a bias load into the accumulator) is the same transfer as an input mvin but moves accumulator-width elements, so it folds onto mvin_A scaled by the accumulator/input datapath width ratio taken from the RTL facts.
